title: Rare Mob Item -warden-
description: The purpose of the mod called RMI (rare mob item) is to make the bosses in the game more useful.
body:
RMI-  V0.5.2

V0.5.2 Released!

RMI<warden>, in short, aims to make the Warden mob more useful.

You can obtain the items in this mode with items from the Warden mob.


What's added in v0.5.2:

Loot tables updated. 
Changed the prompt for sneaky sculk blocks.
What's in This Mode?
 
Items:
Sneaky Piece,
Dead Warden Heart Piece,
Warden Heart Piece,
Insidious Sword,
Insidious Pickaxe,
Insidious Axe,
Insidious Shovel

Blocks:
Warden Heart's Block,
Sneaky Sculk Block


Items with Features:

Warden Heart Piece: While the main hand is held Provides unlimited night vision effect.

Insidious Sword: Applies a darkness effect to the creature that is hit.

Blocks With Features:

Warden Heart's Block: Right-clicking on the block applies a one-hour night vision effect.
